en.why: The element from the previous segment becomes the subject of the next, so there is always only one shape changing in the frame, with empty space around it. Shape, corner radius, and text color inversion happen on the same frame, so the morph reads as one continuous action.
spec: Film 11s. Headline word groups rise 0.2–0.9s; title→line 1.1–1.3s (0.2s, 6 frames), line→capsule 1.3–1.6s (0.3s, 9 frames), capsule→input box 1.7–2.1s (0.4s, 12 frames); typing 2.4–3.95s, send 4.2s; input box→window 4.55–5.3s (0.75s), page blocks 5.0–5.95s; window shrinks into a card 7.0–7.8s (0.8s, 24 frames), 11 gallery cards 7.6–8.6s; closing line→pill 9.15–9.65s, held to 11s

Line expansion, input box and window growth cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) (power3.inOut); capsule thickening, page blocks, shrink into the card and the closing pill cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (expo.out); send press back.out(1.7)
Camera basically fixed; slow linear push 1.00→1.03 over 6.2–7.0s, then 1.03→1.08 with a small pan (x −24px, y −14px) over 7.6–8.6s while the gallery appears; closing drift 1.00→1.025 over 9.6–11s

One black shape (#111111) changes width, height and corner radius together: 960×3 line, 960×96 capsule (radius 48), 920×88 input box (radius 44), 1440×820 window (radius 18, fill #f6f1e8), then a 0.26-scale gallery card among 11 others; the headline shrinks into the input as the placeholder, the avatar and buttons fade in 0.3s (1.8s), and page blocks rise 24px

The headline turns white on the frame after the capsule starts thickening (1.33s, 0.04s); the surrounding gallery stays hidden until the card is formed (cards appear from 7.6s); the window fill flips to cream within the first 0.3s of its growth
Near-white soft-lit background (radial #ffffff → #e9e9e9) with a black shape; one subject throughout; gallery thumbnails use 11 different site styles; closing wordmark white on a 440×112 black pill
en.prompt: Build a continuous morph with no cuts called Morph Relay, an 11-second film on a near-white soft-lit background. A headline (64px, black) rises in word groups. A black line (960×3px) expands from under it (0.2s, power3.inOut cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)). The line thickens into a 96px capsule with expo.out (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)) over 0.3s and the headline inverts to white one frame later. The capsule then narrows into an 88px input box over 0.4s (power3.inOut) while the headline shrinks into the placeholder and an avatar and buttons fade in; type a prompt from 2.4s, press send at 4.2s, then grow the input box into a 1440×820 browser window with an 18px radius over 0.75s (4.55–5.3s) as its fill flips to cream, with page blocks rising 24px (0.5s expo.out each, staggered 0.04–0.06s) from 5.0s. Push in 3% linearly, then shrink the whole window into a gallery card (scale 0.26, 0.8s expo.out) and bring in 11 other cards around it 0.04s apart. Finally the opening line returns, thickens into a black pill and the wordmark appears inside it. Keep the surrounding elements empty so only one shape changes throughout.
says: One thing keeps turning into the next
The title turns into an input box
vs: Wireframe Re-layout strips a group of elements down to wireframes and re-flows them together; Morph Relay changes a single element step by step into another kind of element.
Card Flip to Code shows the front and back of the same card, rotating 180° around an axis; Morph Relay changes shape continuously with no front or back.

zh.why: 上一段的元素直接成为下一段的主体，画面里始终只有一个形体在变，周围留空；形状、圆角、文字反白在同一帧发生，变形读成一次连续动作。
spec: 横线展开、输入框和窗口变形 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)（power3.inOut）；胶囊加厚、页面区块、缩成卡片和收尾胶囊 cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)（expo.out）；发送按压 back.out(1.7)

zh.prompt: 用「形变接力（Morph Relay）」做一段无切镜的连续变形，整段 11 秒，背景近白色柔光。64px 黑色标题按词组上升。标题下展开一条黑色横线（960×3px，0.2s，power3.inOut，cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)）。横线用 expo.out（cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)）0.3s 加厚成 96px 的胶囊，标题晚一帧反白。胶囊再用 0.4s（power3.inOut）收窄成 88px 的输入框，标题缩成占位文字，头像和按钮淡入；2.4s 起打出提示词，4.2s 点发送，然后输入框用 0.75s（4.55–5.3s）长成 1440×820、圆角 18px 的浏览器窗口，填充翻成米色，页面区块从 5.0s 起各上升 24px（expo.out 0.5s，错开 0.04–0.06s）。线性慢推 3%，再把整个窗口缩成画廊卡片（scale 0.26，expo.out 0.8s），周围每隔 0.04s 带入另外 11 张卡片。最后开场那条线回来，加厚成黑色胶囊，字标出现在胶囊里。周围元素保持空白，全程只有一个形体在变。
says: 一个东西一直变成下一个东西
vs: 线框重排是一组元素先退成线框再整体重排；本条是单个元素逐步变成另一种元素

en.title: Morph Transition: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: One black shape morphs from a line to a capsule, an input box, a window and a gallery card with no hard cut. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: One element keeps morphing into the next, replacing cuts, so the whole sequence has no hard cut.
en.name: Morph Transition

body.h2: How to make a Morph Transition with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Animate one black shape (#111111) by width, height and corner radius together: a 960×3 line, a 960×96 capsule (radius 48), a 920×88 input box (radius 44), a 1440×820 window (radius 18), then a 0.26-scale gallery card among 11 others. The line, capsule and input steps take 0.2s, 0.3s and 0.4s, and the window growth takes 0.75s on power3.inOut.

Tie each change to a frame. The headline turns white on the frame after the capsule starts thickening (1.33s), the window fill flips to cream within the first 0.3s of its growth, and the gallery stays hidden until the card forms at 7.6s. The window shrinks into a card over 0.8s on expo.out, and the camera stays nearly fixed.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the shape as one DOM element with the headline, input and gallery around it. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: A typed prompt asking for a coffee roaster landing page turns into the finished page in a browser window.
faq: A morph transition turns one element into the next by animating its shape, size and color continuously. The next scene arrives as the same object, so the sequence has no hard cut.
Can I use a morph transition on a website?
Yes. The film animates the width, height and corner radius of one DOM element with GSAP, which also runs on a page. Keep a single subject on screen at a time so the change reads clearly.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做形变转场
body.body:
让一个黑色形状（#111111）同时改变宽、高和圆角：960×3 的线、960×96 的胶囊（圆角 48）、920×88 的输入框（圆角 44）、1440×820 的窗口（圆角 18），最后缩成 11 张卡片里的一张，缩放 0.26。线、胶囊、输入框三步分别用 0.2s、0.3s、0.4s，窗口放大用 0.75s，缓动 power3.inOut。

每个变化都对齐到具体帧。标题在胶囊开始变粗后的下一帧（1.33s）变白，窗口填充色在放大的前 0.3s 内翻成奶油色，画廊在 7.6s 卡片成形前一直隐藏。窗口用 0.8s 缩成卡片，缓动 expo.out，镜头基本固定。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会把形状做成一个 DOM 元素，周围布置标题、输入框和画廊。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
